title: Weibull recurrent neural networks for failure prognosis using histogram data
summary: This paper presents the first industrial application of Weibull time-to-event recurrent neural networks (WTTE-RNN) for failure prognosis, specifically for predicting turbocharger failures in heavy-duty trucks using histogram condition data. The study demonstrates that WTTE-RNN effectively incorporates both censored and uncensored failure data, and shows that clustering trucks into sub-fleets improves prediction performance when training data is sufficiently large. The paper also introduces a technique for preprocessing sparsely sampled histogram data to enable effective machine learning-based prognosis for predictive maintenance.
